name: Jeju Beer The Barrel Series Blueberry Stout

producer.name: Jeju Beer Company
producer.about: Jeju Beer Company brews at Hallim on Jeju Island. Its brewery was designed with beerBev, uses equipment from the German maker Krones, and can make about 20 million litres a year.

spec.label: Base
spec.value: Barley malt (Germany, Netherlands), wheat malt (Germany), glucose

spec.label: Flavouring or botanicals
spec.value: Blueberry, raspberry and strawberry concentrates; vanilla bean and flavouring; US hop pellets
